full_judgment: 9. I have gone carefully with the trial court and the appellate court record and the judgments. It is found that the foundation of trial court's decision is based on defence witness. The trial court in fact decreed the suit erroneously shifting the burden of proof upon the defendants. He has failed to appreciate the legal position that it is the plaintiff who is to prove his own case and must not depend on defence witness. The appellate court has correctly decided the plaintiff must prove his own case independently.
